title: Perturbation-Based Data Selection for Medical Question Answering
abstract: arXiv:2610.33440v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Selecting a compact training subset is an important step in adapting medical language models from existing question-answering banks. We investigate perturbation-based data selection using two signals derived from Gaussian perturbations of the final-block representation: prediction-change frequency and non-flipping margin contraction. After a shared entropy prefilter, Representation-Sensitivity Prioritization (RSP) combines the signals using automatic root-mean-square scaling, while RSP-Drop ranks candidates by contraction alone. Both selectors use only questions and answer options during selection. We evaluate them with MedGemma-4B on five medical QA datasets at retained-set budgets of 64, 128, and 256 examples. At the primary budget of 128, RSP and RSP-Drop obtain dataset-averaged Macro-F1 scores of 47.55 and 48.28, respectively, compared with 45.11 for entropy-pool-matched random selection. Their relative performance varies across data

translated_title: 基于扰动的医学问答数据选择
translated_abstract: 从现有问答题库中适配医学语言模型时，选择一个紧凑的训练子集是重要的一步。我们研究了基于扰动的数据选择方法，利用从最终块表示的高斯扰动中导出的两个信号：预测变化频率和非翻转间隔收缩。在共享的熵预筛选之后，表示敏感性优先方法（RSP）使用自动均方根缩放来组合这两个信号，而RSP-Drop则仅根据收缩程度对候选数据进行排序。两种选择器在筛选过程中仅使用问题和答案选项。我们在五个医学问答数据集上，使用MedGemma-4B模型在保留集预算为64、128和256个样本的条件下对它们进行评估。在主要的128样本预算下，RSP和RSP-Drop分别获得了47.55和48.28的数据集平均Macro-F1分数，而与熵池匹配的随机选择方法仅为45.11。它们的相对性能因数据集而异。
tldr: 本文提出基于高斯扰动的两种医学问答数据选择方法RSP和RSP-Drop，仅需问题和答案选项即可筛选紧凑高效的训练子集，在128样本预算下显著超越随机选择方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes two perturbation-based data selection methods, RSP and RSP-Drop, which use only questions and answer options to select compact training subsets for medical QA, outperforming random selection at a 128-example budget.
